title: Public listing page shows only approved, available apartments
steps:
1. Open the home page without signing in.
2. Read the result count and cards.
expected: Only approved and Available listings are shown (seed: 7). No pending or rented units.
actual: "7 apartments available" shown; API returned 7 listings, all Available, no owner data.

title: Filter by location and room count
steps:
1. On the home page click Location "Hulhumalé".
2. Click Rooms "2".
expected: Only 2-room apartments in Hulhumalé are listed.
actual: 1 result(s), all Hulhumalé with 2 rooms.

title: Maximum rent filter and price sort
steps:
1. Clear filters.
2. Set the max monthly rent slider to about MVR 13,000.
3. Sort by lowest price.
data: Max rent ≈ 13,000; Sort = low to high
expected: Every listing costs ≤ the cap and appears cheapest first.
actual: Cap MVR 13,000; prices shown 8,900, 11,500, 12,800 (ascending).

title: Apartment detail page for a guest
steps:
1. Open any listing card.
2. Check the panel shown to a signed-out visitor.
expected: Detail shows rent, rooms and branch; no owner details; prompts the guest to sign in to apply or request a viewing.
actual: Detail shown with "Request a viewing" / "Apply" links to sign-in; no owner contact data.

title: Client registration rejects an incomplete form
steps:
1. Go to Sign in → Client → "New here? Create an account".
2. Leave all fields blank and click Create account.
expected: Account is not created; a validation message is shown.
actual: Stayed on the form with message: "firstName: String must contain at least 1 character(s)".

title: Client self-registration creates an account and opens the client portal
steps:
1. Fill the client registration form.
2. Keep "two-step verification" on.
3. Click Create account.
data: Mariyam Tester69182, Female, DOB 1998-04-12, max rent 20,000, phone 791 5555, mariyam.tester69182@example.mv
expected: Account created with a CL- code; two-step verification step shown; user lands on /client.
actual: Redirected to /client as Mariyam Tester69182 (CL-3120).

title: Signing in on the wrong account tab is refused
steps:
1. Open Sign in → Client tab.
2. Enter the owner email and click Sign in.
expected: Sign-in refused with a message telling the user to pick the Owner tab.
actual: Refused: "That account is a owner account. Choose the matching sign-in tab.".

title: Staff sign-in requires an emailed code; a wrong code is rejected
steps:
1. Sign in → Staff, choose Aminath Rasha.
2. Click Sign in; the code screen appears.
3. Enter 000000 and verify.
expected: A six-digit code is emailed; the wrong code is refused and the user stays on the code screen.
actual: Code emailed to the staff mailbox (captured by the test email stub). Wrong code refused: "Invalid or expired verification code.".

title: Staff sign-in with the correct emailed code
steps:
1. Sign in → Staff as Ahmed Afzal.
2. Enter the six-digit code from the email.
expected: Specialist lands on /staff with specialist navigation and "MFA on" shown.
actual: Signed in as STF · Ahmed Afzal (Property Specialist, Malé).

title: Two-step verification for clients/owners checks a real code
steps:
1. Register a client with "Use two-step verification" on (TC-06).
2. On the code screen enter any six digits (987654).
expected: A code is sent to the user and only that code is accepted (brief §2A: MFA optional for external users).
actual: Screen says: "A 6-digit code goes to the phone on your account. Development mode: Clerk is not configured, so any six digits are accepted." — arbitrary digits 987654 were accepted; no code is sent. MFA for external users is simulated.

title: Client applies for an apartment with a chosen lease term
pre: Signed in as the newly registered client (TC-06).
steps:
1. Open Coral Point 8B from Find a home.
2. Choose lease term "2 years".
3. Click Apply for this apartment.
expected: Application is sent and a confirmation with the branch name appears.
actual: Application sent to Branch 2 · Hulhumalé on 8 Nov 2026. A property specialist will verify it and message you.

title: Client requests a viewing; a second request is blocked
steps:
1. On the same apartment click Request a viewing.
2. Check the button afterwards.
expected: Viewing is scheduled; the button changes to "Viewing requested" and is disabled.
actual: Button now reads "Viewing requested · staff will confirm" and is disabled.

title: Tenant logs a maintenance request
pre: Signed in as client@housing-4-raajje.test (active lease on Kanamana Residence 2A).
steps:
1. Open Maintenance.
2. Pick a category and describe the problem.
3. Submit.
data: Category = first option; "Kitchen tap is leaking under the sink."
expected: Request is listed with status Open and an MR- reference; owner is notified.
actual: New request appears at the top of "Your requests" with status Open.

title: Client sends a message through the staff-mediated hub
steps:
1. Open Messages.
2. Select the first conversation.
3. Type a message and click Send.
data: "Can the viewing be moved to Thursday afternoon?"
expected: Message appears in the thread.
actual: Message added to the conversation with the branch staff member.

title: Client updates profile preferences
steps:
1. Open Profile.
2. Change maximum rent to 16,500.
3. Save.
expected: Profile saves; reload shows the new value.
actual: Saved; after reload max rent shows 16,500.

title: Tenant views lease, payment ledger and notifications
steps: 1. Open My lease.
expected: Shows monthly rent, expiry, deposit held, payment ledger with Paid/Overdue states, both signatures and notifications.
actual: Lease LSE-2026-0412 shown with ledger, sign-offs (both signed) and notifications.

title: Apartment registration form rejects missing fields
steps:
1. My properties → Register new apartment.
2. Submit with everything blank.
expected: Form is not submitted; message asks for unit name, address and rent.
actual: Blocked with: "Fill in the unit name, address and monthly rent.".

title: Owner registers an apartment; branch is assigned from the district
steps:
1. Fill unit name, house, goalhi, district Villingili, type Flat, 2 rooms, rent 11,000.
2. Submit for verification.
data: Test Unit 69182, Hiyaa Villa, Rehendhi Higun, Villingili, Flat, 2 rooms, MVR 11,000
expected: Unit listed as Pending approval under Branch 3 Villingili with an APT- reference; it is NOT in public search yet.
actual: "Test Unit 69182" listed as Pending approval (Villingili); not in public search.

title: Owner sets a unit to Under maintenance and back to Available
steps:
1. Availability → Villingili Vista G4.
2. Click Available and confirm.
3. Click Under maintenance and confirm.
expected: Each change asks for confirmation; status updates; under-maintenance units are hidden from public search.
actual: Confirmation dialog shown; unit appeared in public search when Available and disappeared when Under maintenance.

title: A rented unit cannot be set to Available while its lease is active
steps:
1. Availability → Coral Court 1C (Rented).
2. Click Available.
expected: A "Contract still active" dialog blocks the change; the anonymised lease ledger is shown.
actual: Blocked: "Contract still active … cannot be set to Available while lease LSE-2026-0107 is running."

title: Earnings show rent minus the platform fee, with downloadable statements
steps: 1. Open Earnings.
expected: Monthly rent minus the management fee (net payout) shown, with a downloadable statement (brief §2B).
actual: Page shows collected rent by month (e.g. Mar 23.8k = 9,800 + 14,000, i.e. gross), outstanding and year-to-date. Management fee shown: no; downloadable statement: no.

title: Property dashboard: view counter and aggregated rejection reasons (brief §2B)
steps:
1. Open the owner Dashboard and My properties.
2. Look for total views, rejection-reason breakdown and viewing timeline.
expected: Each unit shows total escorted viewings, % per feedback reason (e.g. "Little expensive") and an anonymised viewing timeline.
actual: API returns the data (e.g. Coral Court 1C: 5 views; 20% Financial constraint ("Little expensive"), 40% Size ("Rooms too small"), 20% Furnishing ("Needs more furniture")), but no owner page displays it. Not implemented in the UI.

title: "Approve and publish" stays disabled until every compliance check is ticked
steps:
1. Open Verification queue.
2. Select the first item.
3. Observe the Approve button before ticking checks.
expected: Approve is disabled until all checks are ticked.
actual: Approve disabled with checks unticked.

title: Specialist approves a queued apartment registration after compliance checks
steps:
1. Select an item in the queue.
2. Tick all compliance checks.
3. Click Approve and publish.
expected: Item leaves the queue; confirmation says the applicant was notified; audit entry written.
actual: "Orchid Court 4D" approved; queue 2 → 1; "Approved registration APT-0331. The applicant has been notified. Dismiss"

title: Specialist logs an escorted viewing with standardised feedback
steps:
1. Open Viewings.
2. Pick client, apartment, date, feedback "Financial constraint (Little expensive)" and a comment.
3. Log viewing.
data: Feedback = Financial constraint; comment "Asked if rent is negotiable"
expected: Viewing appears at the top of the log with the staff name and feedback.
actual: Viewing logged and listed with feedback "Little expensive" and the comment.

title: Automated matchmaker lists clients whose budget and location fit a listing
steps:
1. Open Matchmaker.
2. Pick a listing.
3. Click Notify on the first match.
expected: Matches show why they matched (location, rent ≤ max, rooms); notifying writes a notification.
actual: Matches listed with reasons (e.g. Henveiru Loft 1A: CL-3108 "Full match – location, budget, rooms"; three partial matches); first client notified.

title: Specialist generates a lease contract for an available unit
steps:
1. Open Lease execution.
2. Property = Sea Breeze 3B, Client = Mariyam Tester69182.
3. Deposit 18,500, start next month, term 1 year, payment Bank deposit.
4. Generate contract.
expected: Contract LSE-YYYY-nnnn is generated as Awaiting signature, logged under the executing staff ID; renewal reminder date shown.
actual: Contract LSE-2026-0542 generated and logged under STF-014. Client and owner notified by SMS and email to sign.

title: Client signs the lease; it stays Awaiting signature until the owner signs
steps:
1. As the new client open My lease.
2. Click Sign lease.
expected: Client signature recorded; notice says waiting for the owner; lease not yet active.
actual: Client signed; page shows "You signed on …; waiting for the owner."

title: Owner signs; lease becomes Active and the unit becomes Rented
steps:
1. As the owner open Dashboard.
2. Click Sign lease on the prompt.
3. Check public search.
expected: Lease Active; Sea Breeze 3B shows Rented and is removed from public search.
actual: Owner signed → lease Active; Sea Breeze 3B now Rented and hidden from public search.

title: Tenant pays the current month (demo payment mode)
pre: Signed in as client@housing-4-raajje.test (November rent overdue).
steps:
1. Open My lease.
2. Click "Pay November rent".
expected: Month marked Paid; owner payout = rent − management fee; notifications sent.
actual: Clicked "Pay November rent"; ledger row now: "Nov 2026 Online transfer MVR 14,000 Paid".

title: Receptionist routes a walk-in inquiry to a property specialist
steps:
1. Open Inquiries.
2. Choose a specialist for the first inquiry.
3. Click Route.
expected: Inquiry shows as routed to the chosen specialist.
actual: Inquiry routed; row shows the assigned specialist.

title: Receptionist cannot open the verification queue or lease execution
steps:
1. As Receptionist, check the sidebar.
2. Type /staff/queue and /staff/leases in the address bar.
expected: Sidebar shows only Overview, Inquiries, Viewings; direct URLs do not show the restricted pages.
actual: Sidebar: Overview, Inquiries, Viewings. /staff/queue showed "Today"; /staff/leases showed "Today".

title: Branch manager sees reports for their own branch only
pre: Signed in as Branch Manager, Malé (Hassan Zameel).
steps: 1. Open Branch reports.
expected: Report covers Branch 1 Malé only; no branch switcher is offered.
actual: Report header "October 2026 · Branch 1 · Malé"; occupancy and staff tables list Malé only; branch shown as fixed text (no switcher).

title: Administrator provisions a staff account (validation + success)
steps:
1. Staff accounts → enter only "Raya" → Provision (expect error).
2. Enter "Fathimath Raya", Receptionist, Hulhumalé → Provision.
expected: Single name rejected; full name creates an STF- account with a sign-in email.
actual: Validation: "Enter a first and last name.". Created: "STF-020 Fathimath Raya was created as Receptionist. Sign-in email: fathimath.raya@housing-4-raajje.test."

title: Audit log records the actions performed in this run
steps: 1. Open Audit log.
expected: Newest entries include the lease, approval, viewing, routing and account provisioning done above, with actor and branch.
actual: Audit log shows recent actions (found: LSE-2026-0542).

title: Administrator can switch branch scope; overview figures change
steps: 1. Overview → Branch selector = Hulhumalé.
expected: Overview figures and the page subtitle change to Hulhumalé.
actual: Figures and branch table switched to Branch 2 · Hulhumalé, but the subtitle still reads "Work waiting across Branch 1 · Malé." (staff/+page.svelte uses the admin's home branch, not the selected scope).

title: Pages work at phone width (390 px)
steps: 1. Open the home page and the client lease page on a 390 px wide screen.
expected: No horizontal scrolling; navigation collapses to a menu.
actual: No horizontal overflow on either page.
